payload.title: Phase 3 — Task-lock dev-team wiring
payload.trigger: User-explicit ask 2026-05-20: 'i have ask dev team but they dont know system exist / is you use this system now?' Phase 3 deferral (per docs/signals/po-1955-close.json next_phase) lifted on demand.
payload.scope_one_line: Wire task_claim/task_heartbeat/task_release into PO+PM+developer+dev-*+QA+agent-father flows so dev-team sprint-task + dashboard-row work is multi-session collision-safe (Phase 3 of architecture brief 2026-05-20-task-lock-system.md).

architectural_context.phase_1_shipped: commits 79ac45e9 + b3d6ff80 — coordination.db + 4 MCP tools (task_claim, task_heartbeat, task_release, task_list_held)
architectural_context.phase_2_shipped: commits 8b23795a + aaa4a06d + d10112a3 + f38608f5 + 0d518efe → 9357ac38 — cowork-team Step 4.6 slot-locking (Model 1, master holds 900s, no heartbeat)
phase_3_pending_decisions: Model 2 (agent-self heartbeats every 5min) vs Model 1 (master holds): dev-team work spans 5min–60min so Model 2 is the brief default. TTL=3600s for sprint-task, 1800s for dashboard-row.

Relationship with docs/pipeline-state.json: AUGMENT not replace — pipeline-state remains human-readable handoff trail; task-lock provides atomic guard + TTL-based crash recovery. Lock kind sprint-task complements pipeline-state ownership transfer.
Backward-compat with HEAD.lock preflight: keep both — task-lock prevents 2-session same-task race; HEAD.lock prevents same-session git-write race.
Migration on first claim-fail: check pipeline-state.json owner before treating as collision (avoids false-negative skip when one session holds both pipeline-state and a stale lock).
wiring_targets: po flow → sprint-task CLAIM at sprint-kickoff (TTL=3600) + RELEASE at sprint-signoff
pm flow → sprint-task HEARTBEAT extension when plan signal emits
developer + dev-* zone specialists → sprint-task HEARTBEAT every 5min while implementing + RELEASE on RETURN
qa flow → sprint-task HEARTBEAT (continuing review) + RELEASE on approval signal
agent-father flow → sprint-task HEARTBEAT for cross-cutting tasks (skill/agent edits)
dashboard-row CLAIM around DASHBOARD.md write-then-read in dev-team/drain-signals.md Step 0a-D (TTL=1800)
architectural_context.tool_packages_audit: 11 packages already list task_claim/heartbeat/release (developer + 10 cowork). Phase 3 needs: po, pm, architect, ba, qa, fixer, agent-father, ops, system-auditor, cowork-refactory-expert, code-janitor, idea-forge — plus all 9 dev-* (dev-mcp-server, dev-api-gateway, dev-stock-price, dev-technical-analysis, dev-macro-indicators, dev-kinh-dich, dev-alert-engine, dev-pdf-extractor, dev-rag-service, dev-frontend, dev-mainserver-crawls, dev-vps-crawls) which currently inherit via developer.md or own .md.
